name: xfi_speed_test_ViaAuthProxy
description: Runs Xfinity gateway speed-test operations via the xFi Speed Platform through the Apigee dev auth-proxy. Supports the existing synchronous speed test and the asynchronous speed-test start call that returns an executionId for a later result/polling call. Uses GECX dynamic variable "speed_test_server" as the backing service domain (resolved through the Apigee gateway domain in variable "apigee_server"). The x-url is dynamically constructed with the gateway MAC address.
